title: Coastal Corner | Stay On 30a – Luxury Beach Homes In 30a Florida
meta_description: Coastal Corner — a house in Seacrest Beach, Florida. 9 guests · 4 bedrooms · 3.5 bathrooms. Book direct with Stay on 30a.
description_expanded: Welcome to 'Coastal Corner,' a brand-new, beautifully designed beach retreat nestled in the sought-after Seacrest Beach community, where coastal charm meets upscale comfort. Thoughtfully crafted for families and groups, this stylish getaway offers the perfect blend of luxury and laid-back living along iconic 30A.Enjoy effortless beach days with private deeded beach access and complimentary tram service, or soak up the sun at the resort-worthy lagoon-style pool, just moments from your door. Explore charming nearby towns with ease on the included six adult bikes, then return home to unwind in a space that feels both elegant and inviting.Whether you’re sipping coffee on the porch, biking to brunch, or watching the sunset over sugar-white sands, Coastal Corner is your dream beach escape, where every detail is designed for unforgettable moments.HOME HIGHLIGHTSBrand New BuildPrivate Deeded Beach Access**Due to the Hurricane the private beach access will remain closed until the necessary repairs can be evaluated and completed and the structure is deemed safe for use.Resort-Style Community Pool One Block from Home6 Adult BikesBack Patio Featuring Outdoor Dining and Sitting Areas with TVLarge Front Patio with SeatingFully Equipped Gourmet KitchenSmart TVs Throughout the HomeLaundry Room featuring Full Size Washer & DryerGas GrillOutdoor ShowerBeach Gear including Pool Towels, Chairs, Umbrellas, Boogie Boards, Toys & Coolers2 Dedicated Parking Spots with Additional Parking Available Throughout the CommunityBeach Tram Stop to HouseWHAT WE OFFERA STARTER SUPPLY OF PREMIUM AMENITIESBody WashShampooConditionerHand SoapToilet PaperDish SoapDishwasher PodsLaundry DetergentPaper TowelsTrash BagsDish SpongeBath TowelsBed LinensPool TowelsWELCOME BUNDLECoffee Grounds2 Keurig PodsPopcornOlive OilFiji WaterPARKINGTwo parking spaces available (2 driveway). Overflow available throughout the community first come first serve. Passes are required which will be provided by Seacrest security.Included are 6 bicycles (adult) for your convenience.SEACREST BEACH COMMUNITY HIGHLIGHTSSeacrest Beach is one of the charming coastal communities that sits on 30A nestled between Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach. Within the Seacrest community, there is a private beach and just 2 blocks away is the largest resort style family-friendly pool in Northern Florida with over 12,000 square feet of crystal-clear water. When you re ready to take a break from the pool and beach be sure to visit Peddlers Pavilion. Peddlers Pavilion is located in Seacrest Beach and is a collection of fun and unique businesses. Here you will find boutiques offering coastal attire to handmade jewelry. There are also some great local spots for dining. For additional entertainment shopping, dining and local events, take the Scenic 30A bike path to nearby Rosemary Beach, Florida.Please Note:*Seacrest Beach does not allow golf cart rentals.ACCOMMODATIONSSleeps: 94 Bedrooms / 3.5 BathsFIRST FLOORBedroom 1: Bunk Room (Twin over Twin)Bedroom 2: Queen & Twin, EnsuiteBedroom 3: King, EnsuiteBedroom 4: King, EnsuiteAMENITY ACCESSIn order to park and have access to Seacrest Beach amenities, guests are required to complete the online Seacrest Beach HOA Guest Registration packet, prior to their arrival. A link will be sent after the reservation is made. Upon arrival, you can pick up your parking passes and wristbands at the Guest Service Window by the lagoon pool. Guests can enter the lagoon area amenity complex at any of the six gates. There will be a queue outside of the Guest Services office marked by safety yellow beach umbrellas.BEACH ACCESS1. Seacrest Beach community features a private beach on the south side of 30A. There are tram stops though out the community that operate on demand. Upon entering the beach to the left (east), there is onsite chair rental service. La Dolce Vita is the exclusive provider at Seacrest Beach. Guests may bring their own chairs to the beach for set up on the right (west) side of the beach. Prohibited items at the private beach access: wagons, wheeled coolers, tents, and canopies.2. Inlet Beach Public Access. This access has parking, restrooms, and lifeguards during peak season. Located at the end of South Orange Street about 200 yards south of US Hwy 98. Inlet Beach Regional Access is the largest county access and features three dune walkovers and 117 parking spaces. This beach access is one of our personal favorites and a short 10 minute bike ride away!HOUSE RULES*Check-In: After 4PM | Check-Out: Before 10AM*Must be 25 years of age to book. Guests under 25 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian that is staying on premises.*No Smoking: Smoking is strictly prohibited including back porch/deck.*No parties or events.*During busier times and due to limited infrastructure, internet connectivity may be affected. No refunds will be given for connection issues no wifi, or slow wifi.*Capacity for 2 vehicles in the driveway.*Home must remain pet free.IMPORTANT PRIOR TO ARRIVALAll guests will be required to sign a rental agreement, as well as provide a valid ID that matches with the name of the person that made the reservation which includes: 1) a photo of your government issued ID such as a driver s license and 2) a "selfie".Other things to note
